title: Fishbowl Helmet
description: A fishbowl-like helmet/hat that can be used as diving gear. The helmet gives you waterbreathing when you put it on.
body:
A simple mod that adds a fishbowl-like helmet that grants you waterbreathing for as long as you wear it.

To craft it, fill the crafting table with glass blocks and leave the center empty.
